notes.title: Update 2.3.1 - Changelog
notes.content: [h2][b]Recruits![/b][/h2][p][b]Update v2.3.1 [/b]is now available for download. This hotfix includes polishing for the conquest gamemode, further performance enhancements, and also a fix for the issue previously preventing players from joining a server that had the game installed on an HDD or an external SSD.[/p][p][b]Before deploying, remember to clear your cache before joining a server for a smooth operation. [/b]Thank you, recruits![/p][p]If you're looking for other fellow recruits to fight alongside, we suggest joining the[url="https://discord.gg/joinsquad44"] [u][b]Squad 44 Community Discord[/b][/u][/url][b]![/b][/p][p][img notes.title: Free Weekend New Player Kickstart Guide!
notes.content:
[h1][b]New To Squad 44? Let's Get You Up to Speed![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We’re celebrating our free weekend in Squad 44, and with that comes a lot of new recruits to the battlefield. We’re here to help provide you with some tips on how best to understand Squad 44 if it's your first time playing![/p][p][/p][p]This write-up was made possible thanks to the incredibly thorough guide created by [b]Sgt. Bagel[/b] and [b]Kermit[/b]. A must-read if you're looking for in-depth details and insights, which we will link below. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3139538772"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We also want to extend our appreciation to our amazing Content Partners, [b]Boogie5[/b] and [b]Bushwicks[/b], and Community Members, [b]Elise [/b]and [b]Herr Wolf Gaming [/b]for their continued support and contributions to this as well!
[/p][p]With that, we hope this small guide gets you off on the right foot for battle recruits! If you want to speak to some fellow Squad 44 players we also suggest joining the [url="https://discord.gg/vqGf8yFp2x"][b]Squad 44 Discord[/b][/url]![/p][p][/p][p]For an Italian localization, please check out this version by [b]Balumba - [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3538971947"]Guida per nuovi giocatori di Squad 44[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Beginner Kits/Classes[/b][/h2][p]In [i]Squad 44[/i], players must choose a role (Kits/Classes) before they can spawn in. Each role determines the soldier’s loadout, including their primary weapon, sidearm, grenades, and specialized equipment. Your chosen role significantly shapes your responsibilities on the battlefield and within your squad.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Infantry Classes Overview[/b][/h2][p]Infantry classes in [i]Squad[/i] 44 are divided into three main categories:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Lead Roles[/b][/h3][p]These include the [b]Platoon Leader[/b] and [b]Squad Leader[/b]. Leadership roles are crucial for coordinating the team and rely heavily on player experience and communication skills. Each of these roles is limited to one per squad and is best suited for players comfortable with making strategic decisions under pressure.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcT1LIF7yEX23EPm_5Z_idjQB1q4mXGdbJnKBsRK-WLRwnuwvE2HZRjhtTGiw2nJL_MPkiXFf6f4oPw6TW-o6-a4nT-n4ey4iyzjkQBBr3UMArsuBmEqSKDkhEf-0U-YlcFl7MK?key=YdbS9YTRoUV-hKzYBlZSZg"][/img][/p][p]Still on the fence about taking command? Our partner Boogie5 has you covered with a tactical briefing. Check out his video guide on how to lead your squad into battle on the Pacific Front![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S-eO5xkFJPU"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]2. Standard Roles[/b][/h3][p]Standard roles make up the bulk of the squad and are often more beginner friendly due to their more simple playstyle. (Shoot, Rearm, Revive or shoot a lot!) These include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Riflemen[/b] – No limit per squad.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Medics[/b] – Up to 2 per squad.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gunners[/b] – Typically limited to 1 per squad, except for specific factions (e.g., the 1940 French can have both an LMG and an Automatic Rifle in the same squad).[/p][/*][/list][p]These standard roles are heavily recommended for new players until you understand the basics of how Squad 44 plays![/p][p]If you want to dive deeper into these roles, our partner Bushwicks has put together comprehensive guides that we strongly suggest you check out![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8zbwdLxTqsg"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_lrkorcjc_0"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]3. Specialist Roles[/b][/h3][p]Specialist roles offer access to unique weapons and equipment. Examples include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Anti-Tank[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Marksman[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sapper[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Flamethrower[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Grenadier[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfsxxAROiE_fIQ1F0HXu308VkxdiddLdrvB69ao5qnR79fwNkzx7KdFxc6HZHSe0ruGyt7zwPyepe3qzK1rPFHKLUIUWebxSuf9_t_JJkULhFf5zssMrC2rIu9enw9oErRsvtTG?key=YdbS9YTRoUV-hKzYBlZSZg"][/img][/p][p]Each squad may only have up to [b]2 specialist roles[/b], and many of these roles are further restricted on a team-wide basis. Typically limited to [b]2–4 players[/b] depending on the faction and time period.[/p][p]These roles are among the most challenging to master, often requiring a significant investment of time, practice, and tactical understanding. There's usually high expectation from teammates for players in these roles to perform well, which can make the learning curve steep.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]The Logistic Role[/b][/h2][p]In Squad 44, logistics isn't just a support role, it's the foundation of your team's success. A well-organized logistics effort keeps the frontline supplied, the defenses reinforced, and the team in the fight. Without it, even the best squads can crumble due to lack of spawn points, ammo, or fortifications.[/p][p]The Logistics Squad plays this vital role, specializing in building and maintaining Forward Operating Bases (FOBs) that act as player spawns and other strategic positions. Typically made up of four players, this squad operates with dedicated vehicles and tools designed specifically for transporting supplies, constructing emplacements, and resupplying both infantry and armor.[/p][p]Whether you're hauling materials across contested ground or fortifying a critical objective, logistics is what keeps the war machine running. Neglect it, and the consequences are swift and unforgiving.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Vehicle Classes Overview[/b][/h2][p]Operating a tank isn’t a solo job. It’s a team effort. Every tank, regardless of nation or model, shares a set of core crew positions. Each plays a vital role in keeping the vehicle combat-ready, though some are more central to the tank’s function than others. [/p][list][*][p][b]Driver[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hull Gunner[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Main Gunner[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Tank Commander[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]While you [i]can[/i] get by with just two crew members, a full crew of three or four significantly boosts effectiveness, especially in combat-heavy situations where manoeuvrability, target selection and positive communication is critical. Whether you're behind the gun or patching up damage under fire, each position has its part to play in turning your armored beast into a battlefield force.[/p][p]As each tank is unique, Herr Wolf Gaming has created a Newbie Guide that goes over a lot of their strengths and weaknesses, helping Tankers and Anti-Tank players get to grips with the mechanics![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hu0yiFLyaNQ"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Communication is Highly Recommended![/b][/h2][p]Communication is the key to victory. By default, you can chat locally with your team using the “V” key, and communicate with your squad using the “B” key. You can adjust right/left audio channels and keybinds in the Settings menu to fit your playstyle. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/e74151c6506e8eae6445634b1c319316a8284375.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/32280d9421064b148420f771b33b2872784242e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Having a microphone is highly recommended. It lets you quickly call out enemy positions, vehicle movements, incoming fire, and more. Spotting an enemy FOB or a marksman watching your spawn? Relay that intel to your team for your Squad Leader or Radioman to mark, allowing you to focus your firepower and crush the opposition before they get the upper hand.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]It’s OK to Make Mistakes![/b][/h2][p][b]Mistakes are part of the learning process, especially if you’re new[/b], but it's important to approach them with a genuine desire to improve. Don’t hesitate to use your comms and ask your fellow recruits for help if you’re ever unsure or lost. Most are happy to guide you, especially if they see you're making an effort to learn.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Your Map is Your Friend![/b][/h2][p]By default, you can open the map with the “M” key, and access a larger, more detailed version with the “N” key. The map displays all intel your team has gathered such as incoming artillery strikes, discovered FOBs, enemy infantry movements, enemy tank positions, and, most importantly, your teammates’ positions. Make it a habit to check your map regularly to reduce the risk of friendly fire and stay one step ahead on the battlefield. In addition there is a compass so use the degrees and cardinal directions if you’re next to your teammates for better call-outs![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcq68VicNWGkVlpkXFmlF2LLoP1mX4VtZGdF-TuNdRYulXWBMw4_QBu7LS-EgNZQcT-eT_vN3lbTkVf0PElQG9XYxz0ve0ri-3PaY3YEa-XAkUZ3Cm5D8dIrSKS4dIM3phVFdM?key=YdbS9YTRoUV-hKzYBlZSZg"][/img][/p][p][b]Tip from the devs:[/b] If you’re using the old pop up compass you can bind the map to the same key for quicker and easier navigation on the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Follow the Server Rules![/b][/h2][p]Since Squad 44 servers are community-run, many have their own specific rules and regulations. It’s always best to read through the server rules on the faction selection page before you start as breaking them; could get you kicked or banned! [/p][p]One rule you'll always find: if you team-kill a friendly, make sure to apologize in chat. It goes a long way! [/p][p]Unsure what server to join? We have some suggestions below! [/p][h3][b]Infanterie Regiment 9 \[IR9] - EU/German[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/246c932c78a82e62095e5212946d289e3c912795.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]"[/b]The IR9 is a [b]Squad44[/b] Regiment established in June 2018. We consider ourselves what is internationally known as a "Realism Unit." This means we drill based on historical Wehrmacht regulations and [b]regularly compete in friendly clan matches[/b] against other international units [b]in vanilla and PSRM events[/b]. With our pool of an average of 30 active players and weekly events and training programs, we are one of the largest and most active communities in the German WW2 Realism scene" -[b] [url="https://discord.gg/4aU6yT6x3G"]Discord[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Corrupted Infantry \[CI] - EU[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/11fdc2261553f0d955d358f7556c164892178116.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]"[b]Who are we?[/b] We are a casual, new player-friendly community that loves to play games and have fun together. Established in 2020, we have since grown to nearly 6000 members (on our Discord) and represent one of the top EU Squad 44 and Squad communities. [b]Who are we looking for?[/b] Be at least 18 years of age, have a microphone, and have a positive attitude. It doesn't matter if you just got the game or have already hit 1000+ hours, everyone is welcome!" - [b][url="https://discord.gg/nqyrrx3dWR"]Discord[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Sitzkrieg \[SK] - EU/German[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/9b9256eea70e1e5663ed1686515f77fef892baa8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]"Sitzkrieg is a German-speaking community of Squad 44 and thus can be found in the EU region, but also allows English-speaking players. We strongly emphasize structured teamplay and communication to ensure top-quality gameplay on our servers. We are very open towards new players and offer training sessions and guidance for them; all they have to do is reach out to us via Discord or in-game." - [b][url="https://discord.gg/NtQXcaVxva"]Discord[/url][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Additional Tips and Videos![/b][/h2][list][*][p]Drink your canteen! (Depending on the game mode) Squad 44 uses a stamina system to restore your stamina, every soldier in their loadout has a canteen, with which stamina can be replenished faster than not moving. [/p][/*][*][p]You can queue for a server while playing in another! If your preferred server is full, no worries! Join a different one for now, then open the server browser to queue up for your desired server. That way, you won’t miss your spot in your preferred server, while honing your skills elsewhere.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoke grenades are your best ally on the battlefield. If you’re taking fire and can’t pinpoint the enemy’s exact location, throw it in their general direction, deploying smoke can give you the cover you need to survive. Use them wisely![/p][/*][*][p]Headshots make a distinct helmet noise but while pistol headshots will kill in one shot, the sound will not trigger. SMG headshots, however, will give you that satisfying audio cue.[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M0v4Vy-AJFU&t=6s"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=evXjO3yUxHo"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Free Weekend and Sale![/b][/h2][p]If you haven't already noticed, [i]Squad 44[/i] is running a [b]Free Weekend Operation[/b] from [b]Thursday, July 31st, through Sunday, August 3rd[/b]. During this time, we're also proud to celebrate [b]10 Years of Offworld [/b]with a major sale event.[/p][p]Now's the time to try out Squad 44 for free and try out the newest gamemode Conquest in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/736220/view/515216422280897884"][b]Update V2.3[/b][/url][b]. [/b]For those who try out the game mode, we welcome your feedback on our [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfX8CuIMd4B34vITpPp5-3o-g2lNs89ZdaL3bPBWZgOseMPKg/viewform"][b]Google Form[/b][/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/f11b2a92ecb07e47def17122496080bf8ebc95b5.png"][/img][/p][p]All of our titles are available at a discount including [i]Squad 44[/i], which will be marked down by [b]50%[/b]. If you've enjoyed your time with [i]Squad 44[/i], now’s the perfect moment to secure it at a fraction of the price.[/p][p]Don’t miss out![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/736220/Squad_44/"][/dynamiclink][/h2]

notes.title: Update 2.3 - Changelog
notes.content: [h2][b]Recruits![/b][/h2][p][b]Update v2.3 [/b]will be available to download on [b]July 29th at 11 AM PT[/b]. This update brings further optimization improvements, a new gamemode, two new infantry weapons, two new flamethrower tanks, and several significant bug fixes![/p][p]We have implemented a temporary fix for the HDD loading bug. However, we continue to advise players to install Squad 44 on an SSD instead of an HDD to achieve better performance while we wait for EAC support.[/p][p][b]Before deploying, remember to clear your cache before joining a server for a smooth operation. [/b]Stay sharp out there![/p][p]If you haven't and want to chat with fellow players about Update v2.3 please join the [url="https://discord.gg/vqGf8yFp2x"][b]Squad 44 Discord[/b][/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/6591619b8f4cf0a79599e1616a02d5070c770020.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]New tanks are missing from the Arnhem Range.[/p][/*][*][p]New tanks have excess flamethrower magazines.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicles driven out of bounds don't die in conquest (players do).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfcrpefxN_lBXCmEZ8OMM9Xpgfn0tZunlraYpmRaFNtaJUvBLJZzCh5PmqJx5kYCJlRo8wj6PJmhWTKAVBVeXvClnZyUA4xk6vbmOL2GV2Vzd1XrIzdyG43zIQBVEMqA553sPM?key=2WgfwS-EOAYdpYAcJj4jYA"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Possible FPS bleed fix (Please see wood/concrete shockwave emitter fix in "General Fixes" for more info).[/p][/*][*][p]Possible memory leak fix related to revive and heal icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Further work on limb and helmet physics for gore.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new HLODs to multiple maps.[/p][/*][/list][p][img notes.title: Conquest Gamemode Public Playtest and Free Weekend Incoming!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Recruits![/b] [/h2][p]We're pleased to report that a new game mode is now in active development in addition to our ongoing operations across Squad 44. To sharpen it for frontline duty, we’ll be conducting a [b]public playtest[/b] and calling on the community to step forward, take the field, and deliver hard-earned feedback from the front.[/p][p][i]“While our coders have been focused on optimisation, we gave our blueprinters the challenge of coming up with a new game mode that could bridge the gap for new players, while offering a new challenge for our more competitive veterans. [/i][/p][p][i]The Conquest gamemode is the product of their hard work. With the action focused in a smaller area and the ability of players to spawn on their Squad Leader established, players can jump straight into the action in a much more focused, high intensity battle, where control of territory constantly shifts back and forth to the benefit or detriment of your team. [/i][/p][p][i]We hope this gamemode will offer new players a more fun and graduated learning curve as they join the ranks of our community and get used to squad play, while also offering veterans and clans more opportunities to hone their skills; fighting it out in a more competitive, frantic game mode, where small unit tactics really do matter.” - [b]Katz, Project Lead, Mercury Arts[/b][/i][/p][h2][b]Conquest[/b][/h2][p]The [b]Conquest Gamemode [/b]is [b]64 player[/b] smaller-scale, territory control operation in which two opposing factions engage in a tactical struggle to exhaust the enemy’s [b]Reinforcement Tickets[/b]. Victory is achieved by capturing and holding key strategic positions designated as [b]flags[/b] across the battlefield, while simultaneously neutralizing enemy forces.[/p][p]The match is won by the side that depletes the opposing team's tickets to zero, or by holding the higher ticket count when time runs out. Controlling more flags than the enemy initiates a [b]Ticket Bleed[/b], gradually wearing down their reserves. The rate of this bleed increases based on flag superiority. Holding a single extra flag causes a slow drain, while a three-flag advantage accelerates enemy losses significantly.[/p][p]As an overview, each Conquest map follows roughly the same setup.[/p][list][*][p]5-7 neutral flags spread across the map.[/p][/*][*][p]2 protected main bases (One for each team).[/p][/*][*][p]600 tickets for each team per map.[/p][/*][*][p]Default 60-minute matches.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Capturing Flags[/b][/h3][p]When a neutral flag is first captured.[/p][list][*][p]An Ammo crate is spawned at the flag for the controlling Team.[/p][/*][*][p]Vehicles may spawn at the flag for the controlling Team.[/p][/*][*][p]Flags will change depending on who is in possession of the capture point.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Spawning[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Squad Leader - Squad members can spawn on their Squad Leader in this new gamemode.[/p][/*][*][p]Flag Spawns - Captured flags can be spawned on if no opposing forces contest the flag.[/p][/*][*][p]Mainbase Spawn - Available as in the standard game.[/p][/*][/list][p]This new game mode delivers a [b]faster-paced experience[/b] compared to our existing modes and is still very much a [b]Work-In-Progress and subject to change[/b]. That’s why we’ll be conducting our [b]First Public Playtest[/b] this weekend from [b]Friday, July 25th at 10:00 AM PT[/b] to [b]Monday, July 28th at 10:00 AM PT[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/67d897cbf65f500aaf2bf1867efdb5d8da3fb396.png"][/img][/p][p]As this is a public playtest. This will be held on the [b]Squad 44 - Public Testing [/b]Application and you will not be able to find any Conquest servers on the default game app. Please ensure you download the Public Testing app ahead of time. If you cannot locate it in your library, go to the top of Steam, click on “[b]View[/b]”, and then “[b]Hidden[/b] [b]Games[/b]”.[/p][p]With that we’re calling on the community to jump in, test it out, and help us shape its future. Your feedback will be critical in refining the mode for full deployment. If you haven't yet we also suggest joining the [b][url="https://discord.gg/vqGf8yFp2x"]Squad 44 Discord[/url][/b] to better aid this public test![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Free Weekend Incoming![/b][/h2][p]Get ready, soldiers! In addition to all the news coming your way, Squad 44 will be hosting a [b]Free Weekend[/b] from [b]Thursday, July 31st, through Sunday, August 3rd[/b]. That means full access to the game completely free for the entire weekend![/p][p]If you've got friends who’ve been on the fence or curious about jumping into the action, this is the perfect chance to squad up and show them what they’ve been missing. Whether they're veterans of the genre or totally new recruits, now’s the time to rally your crew, share the word, and enlist together.[/p][p]No strings attached. No better time to join the fight.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/ad14d3d28ea8299645194a262134886c5858b6ca.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]
[b]Mark your calendars and prepare for battle![/b][/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: Squad 44 Modding Spotlight - Summer 2025
notes.content:
[h2][b]Attention, Recruits![/b][/h2][p]Welcome to the [b]Squad 44 Modding Spotlight,[/b] a front-row seat to the creativity, passion, and innovation fueling the incredible Squad 44 Community![/p][p]In this special showcase, we shine a bright light on [b]three [/b]of the most impressive and game-changing mods being crafted by our talented community members. [/p][p]What you're about to see is direct from the modders themselves, their updates, screenshots, stories, and visions brought to life. Every piece of content has been crafted with care, and we’re thrilled to present their amazing work to you.[/p][p]So gear up and check out these wonderful projects![/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Chapter Red: Bloody Fall - The Redland Collective[/b][/h2][p]This is your moment. Choose your uniform, ready your rifle, and step into the frozen heart of the Eastern Front. Fight through snow-covered steppes, dense forests, and burned-out villages as you take part in the desperate struggle to defend the Soviet capital. [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdJVUZo-7v5k0mT4IPLYF-bVWOsOrq_kW6QTG4FTBOCowdXtYNhllbpCdLV4EWltMF9-kLQfzfDsffflxQx5LCaPwps8ySrTEm8FmoJVJQTSXTlVsoaQRMIGKct7FuRUXlTcHA?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][/p][p]From the last brutal stages of Germany’s advance to the opening volleys of the Battle of Moscow, experience the chaos, courage, and carnage that defined this pivotal turning point of the Second World War.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/8ZfkX5Z4u9E?si=lGcppKkW0J32cg-V"][/dynamiclink][/p][list][*][p]Coordinate with your logistics squad to deploy powerful support weapons such as the [b]M1902 field gun[/b] and the [b]DShK heavy machine gun[/b].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Rain destruction from afar with the devastating rocket salvos of the [b]BM-13 "Katyusha"[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Climb into the steel beasts of the Red Army [b]T-34s[/b], [b]KV-1s[/b], [b]BT-7s[/b], and [b]T-60s[/b] and dominate the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfFHJp8XU9nhid03Qqu7wwHV86WioYVRLksboqP3RkJXRnCBiNyvvg87A9Lp_WhPi-zSm34gSz-wxfEoS42jyd2jlxRdPgIXL4IfxfBuhR0nts0UQ1S8ZGezGbNGddmr9jZ4wBa?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][/p][p][b]Chapter Red: Bloody Fall[/b] is in their words a complete overhaul of [i]Squad 44[/i] brings the early Eastern Front to life as an entirely new chapter. Featuring over 30 new weapons and equipment, a wide array of gear, more than 25 new vehicles, two immersive maps, and custom environmental props, this update also includes authentic Soviet uniforms and revamped, historically accurate German attire. In total, more than 200 custom assets have been added to enrich the experience. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXchAnUfLDRpfDX4cvVM3LLr1lxOfvD7YX-7Kk6K_wMgghVAUT0MuCN7euHMovgx6WFOksp6x4YD5-2RK-y491dcecQTNreb0rXcchU86VelieQqwXcvhytQ3Xj7kuMqRxU9UL4?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][/p][p]The Redland Collective has shared that they are not done working on this wonderful mod as they have some updates coming as the Collective looks to do a showcase of their next update v1.4 around[b] late September [/b]including a [b]major announcement[/b]! Tune into their Discord to keep up to date with when their update is to drop![/p][h3][b]Chapter Red Links:[/b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3126699237"][u][b]Steam Workshop[/b][/u][/url][b] / [url="https://discord.gg/KRS6cNVQCU"][u]Discord[/u][/url][/b][/h3][hr][/hr][h2][b]Chapter Weserübung - Weserübung Devs[/b][/h2][p][b]Chapter Weserübung[/b] sets out to bring new life to a rarely explored part of World War II. The German invasion of Denmark, also known as [i]The Six Hour War[/i], and the subsequent invasion of Norway under [i]Operation Weserübung[/i].[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe26R60J1LdMnYZwYloFtxKbv8hDVfIcU82Kn1C4WzYXp6NMEJvh6xU3QhUTHD-x25FdSNv7upCBYn4aT7BoRnoGxQEUMVb2mCfvcaPrjSlKXk7QfaYQLZB8lasuUYkrmzbiK0?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][/p][p]The developer's current focus is solely on the Invasion of Denmark, beginning with a detailed recreation of the Battle of Haderslev, with plans for a potential second, yet-to-be-revealed map. These battles were fought between the Danish Jutland Division and Germany’s 170th Infantry Division, offering a diverse array of weapons, vehicles, and equipment that we plan to bring into the mod for an authentic and immersive experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfbC96mw_bB7Q1l3hbVb5elRnHwK0_vP70ooLDyOHhmZDecg0taeE0LMiOd7_unkHG5Fghby2SKylqaXRAYNC-2oGsVCd7smknA4LQRYoLnRWcVD_tiR59Lr1koz8um9BJ8p3rh?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXelFLAniBeRXm7Frn90voUTT0AEwC8JZEzwE_s7vKu2jVdrIgRTXBTWZ54ySH5P6VPaWWNukUx5e99-OVH0SHJ8MPSzbeq7qvImyjgEEC9akWfoUBm89xrKUj47Qc6uGQ4JVc4?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][/p][p]While their attention is solely focused on Denmark for now, Norway is a setting they wish to portray and have not yet ruled out expanding the chapter to include the large variety of aspects the front holds. [/p][p]Chapter Weserübung has completed roughly 20 custom assets so far, ranging from tanks and small arms to detailed uniform pieces. The team currently consists of just three dedicated members; aiming for a release of the Danish theatre and custom faction in early-mid [b]2026[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcrUD_SjewXRQTM6gP3bVyJt3kiM1l80MPqnCU6CqiSq03bJ69bzcCei1qSv9g5_da3Hl5DNNbs-av3e8nurXJTTCjd8-jenYjw35QYgxXchUxSyLJkcNg0qabsH7oiKZ5uJ7wR?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf1-9q6HxrdKelQPbtufXToxtKpM_5azVgNhvr7Y91NiGcI2PVb7xoxbn5fpugpcPRWAzj6E0ghAsCH7xG096p2XNo7rJ8YCeVEGTYcAvW8TakQ-4rA2CKFPBULaifw1J3crlah?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][/p][p]We highly suggest joining their Discord below to keep track of their development![/p][h3][b]Weserübung Links:[/b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3309800677"][u][b]Steam Workshop[/b][/u][/url][b] / [url="https://discord.gg/E5rrwfWjdN"][u]Discord[/u][/url][/b][/h3][hr][/hr][h2][b]Turning Tides - Rising Sun Studio[/b][/h2][p]In November 1943, while brutal combat raged in the mountains of Italy and across the frozen steppes of Russia, a very different battlefront was coming to life thousands of miles away in the vast, open expanse of the Central Pacific. Scattered like stepping stones across the ocean, the Gilbert and Marshall Islands remote chains of coral atolls and sandy islets were about to become the focus of a daring new campaign aimed at shifting the tide of the Pacific War.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfn8kBW6wU0O5E3K7GsnTfP0ShE_bY8GN4e2tUA9U5-otBpMTWqCN4Ar5D7ri1bnMhHj-i0YK5F6MCZm8HAwU_whL1craXvRWPzFwdl0_ds3edplaF8zLyRgnz8T46f2Eq_ZOhQ?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][/p][p][b]Turning Tides[/b] is a community-driven mod project dedicated to bringing the intense, often overlooked battles of the Pacific Theater into Squad 44. Launched in the summer of 2025, the project unites passionate developers and history enthusiasts from around the world, all driven by a shared commitment to authenticity, immersive gameplay, and honoring the legacy of one of World War II’s most grueling and dynamic theaters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdJcYNHhj56BreHUzHnW0Tm3pGtqhnEHEg5YHrhfZ71ScK-gLDq8JjEzRmETnHZumzG3MuaNBESWZxTy2t-b9fBrH__A6yuJclcLy-FbyFPquYDfTqyKkpwP8R213fq5vC62eVO?key=eziQTOsFqhD41QXWzHnkDA"][/img][/p][p]At the heart of this chapter are meticulously crafted, 1:1 recreations of both Betio and Kwajalein Islands, presented as they were on the exact days of their historic invasions. Every trench line, bunker, and fortification has been researched and rebuilt with painstaking accuracy, offering players an experience that captures the full intensity of close-quarters island warfare.[/p][h3][b]Turning Tides Links: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3523726854"][u]Steam Workshop[/u][/url] / [url="https://discord.gg/S9tRVjZmgY"][u]Discord[/u][/url][u]
[/u][/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p]The passion, talent, and historical dedication shown by these teams are what keep the [i]Squad 44 [/i]community active. [/p][p]Whether you're a seasoned player or just discovering the world of modding, there's never been a better time to dive in, support these incredible creators, and become part of the action. Each project brings something unique to the battlefield. So gear up, join the fight, and help shape the future of [i]Squad 44[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, keep your eyes on the horizon... more is always on the way.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.2.1 - Changelog
notes.content: [h2][b]Recruits![/b][/h2][p][b]Update v2.2.1 [/b]will be available to download at [b]11AM PT[/b]. Work continues behind the scenes to bring out another hotfix for HDD loading. We have determined that the EAC update caused this issue. We will work with EAC to rectify this issue for players as a priority. [/p][p]In the meantime, we [b]highly suggest[/b] players install Squad 44 on an [b]SSD[/b] instead of an [b]HDD[/b] to prevent long loading times and server timeouts.[/p][p][b]Before deploying, remember to clear your cache before joining a server for a smooth operation. ([b]Work-In-Progress[/b])[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/02f7de166fd1e45c4f8caf8acea84e53fb82e73e.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added a get custom server setting to assist server hosts.[/p][/*][*][p]The sound menu now includes left ([b]L[/b]) and Right ([b]R[/b]) for headset audio splitting options.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated map list for server hosts.[/p][/*][*][p]Updates made to anti-cheat logging to provide more info.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/5747f25aef86fbd4f3d8341d20c8c6f495911a8f.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Renault FT tanks causing FPS issues and crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed active capzone marker widget to no longer be greyed out when active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the duplication of spawn points in the respawn menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a stutter while running through some bushes on Guadalcanal.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Japanese flamethrower pipe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tracks not appearing on some mechanized vehicles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed radio bleed-out sound replicating to all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing texture on the Japanese radioman's radio.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed always on UI for 2D compass.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Vickers, Pz3, Pz.38t, and Pz.4H tracer offset on MGs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed N-wheel vehicles having the incorrect fuel component destroy FX.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the crashed plane site wreck interior.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong display name for some German AT/AA guns.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Heelsum terrain ([b]exception FOV 120[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed swamp tree fire not visible on daylight layers.[/p][/*][*][p]Implementing a potential fix for M3 gun replication on Guadalcanal.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Leviathan of the Pacific Approaches
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/9320f763435def90dc14d0f505a22e97f2f45cf4.jpg[/img]

Recruits!

A new foe has appeared… something we don’t know how to explain, but it's far more menacing than the war we are in. Some information we received comes from the Japanese Forces, and we don’t take you for a fool, so we have disclosed this to all active American troops as there may be a bigger fight ahead for us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/3fc440d593aa1bd2775b6747e01d086a9aae9fcf.jpg[/img]

Amid the fierce battle for Iwo Jima, an event occurred that defied all logic and understanding. From the sea to the west, a colossal creature emerged. They call it a “Kaiju”, unlike anything known to man.

The beast stood over 100 meters tall, its body dark and jagged like cooling lava. Its eyes glowed like embers, and each step shook the island. It did not distinguish between Japanese or American forces. It attacked everything in its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/2d56fa44e75a9d5841ff6a53bb13532d255c97b1.jpg[/img]
Both sides opened fire. Battleship artillery, tank shells, and explosive charges had no effect. The kaiju retaliated with a blue-white breath of searing energy, instantly melting steel and incinerating men. Naval ships destroyed within seconds. Bunkers collapsed. Entire platoons vanished in flame.

After rampaging across the battlefield, the creature returned to the sea, leaving only charred ruins and silence in its wake. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/f7aefcabab1091480378d9e86ba09f8b7a945a8f.jpg[/img]

“Iwo Jima was already hell. Then something worse came from the sea.

It rose from the waves, a mountain of black stone, eyes burning like nothing I've ever seen. Our ships fired first. Nothing. We threw the entire arsenal at it. Nothing.

Then it roared, and then came the shrieking blue fire. Ships melted. Men turned to ash. It stomped onto shore, crushing everything like we were ants.

I ran. I don’t know why it didn’t get me. Maybe it never even noticed. Maybe I was just lucky, or maybe just maybe it showed mercy.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/de5c2f582e3699602723354c888ab948fe308896.jpg[/img]
Due to the overwhelming losses in men, ships, and supplies caused by this so-called kaiju, all planned deployments have been canceled until further notice.

However, we’re not letting your talents go to waste. We need every sharp mind strategizing and working together to figure out how to deal with this “Leviathan of the Pacific.” Head over to the [url=https://discord.gg/vqGf8yFp2x][b]Squad 44 Community Discord[/b][/url] to discuss with your fellow recruits and help us formulate a strategy.

[h2][b]One hell of an April 1st isn’t it recruit?[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Squad 44 - 6-Month Roadmap (March 2025)
notes.content:
[h2][b]Recruits![/b][/h2]

It has been a while since the Pacific Front was released. We're still hard at work, but we are back with a new roadmap to give you all a glimpse of what is to come for Squad 44. With that Katz of Mercury Arts has some more insights on our roadmap. So, let us dive right into it!

Please note: All this information is work-in-progress and subject to change, and we plan to release another roadmap later this year to keep you updated on changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/a88bce06cb06d61f6ec456c86e794edd281a948f.png[/img]
[h2][b]Current Operations[/b][/h2]
“[b]Current Operations[/b]” are changes that will be included in the next update (or have already happened!).

While we are delighted with the player base's reception of the release of Iwo Jima and the Japanese and USMC factions, we want to continue polishing this content.

As such, optimization and bug fixing are our main focus in the short term, with work also ongoing to refine existing game mechanics. This includes optimization and a new UI for the flamethrower, further work on the mini-map, refinements for the frontline game mode, and various fixes for vehicle/tank performances!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/41870d75644264e3004a9a2d38f88ee470c2da5e.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]In Concept[/b][/h2]
“[b]In Concept[/b]” are changes that are currently being actively developed for future updates coming to Squad 44!

Having upgraded DLSS, NIS, and FSR to the latest versions accepted by the game engine in our previous patch, we have been working hard to upgrade the game’s [b]Easy Anti-Cheat[/b] software to the latest version accepted by the game engine. This upgrade, along with some work done behind the scenes by our coders, will now allow users the ability to play the game on the [b]Linux[/b] operating system.

With this change opening the game to Linux users, we are also looking to build on the in-game help system we previously released, with a future tutorial and further accessibility options, to provide new players with a greater onboarding experience without compromising gameplay for our veterans.

Work also continues at pace on the second Pacific map, [b]Guadalcanal[/b]. This map will again present players with the unique experience provided by a truly historically accurate battlefield on a one-to-one scale, with Marines pushed to the limit defending Henderson Field against waves of Japanese attacks. Players will also need to keep an eye out for flamethrower tanks coming to the game, with the “Ronson” Sherman ready to turn up the heat on Iwo Jima.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/376ca960ce2c1aab1bd2398a19e6db4239c4d755.png[/img]
[h2][b]Future Operations[/b][/h2]
“[b]Future Operations[/b]“ are plans for the far future, highly subject to change, and could take [b]longer than 6 months[/b] to implement.

We make no apologies for keeping quiet on this one, but what we can say is that alongside a third Pacific map, you can expect to find new game mechanics and new game modes coming to the game, offering players an ever greater immersive and rewarding experience on the battlefield.

Whether you are of a competitive nature or a re-enactor type, we have much more coming for you to look forward to throughout 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/5643cf198b908c2ee298feba867c4ebc6878ad87.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 2.0 UPDATE - The Pacific Front: Iwo Jima
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=s1oVFCd5mnM;full][/previewyoutube]
Folks,

It’s finally here. Today, on the 80th anniversary of the Battle of Iwo Jima, is the first update for the Pacific Front. Let’s go over the first Pacific Front update and the first new map, Iwo Jima! 

[h1]What’s New[/h1]

[h2]The Pacific Front - Iwo Jima[/h2]

This update brings the battle to the island of Iwo Jima, with the Imperial Japanese Army defending its territory against the invading United States Forces. The in-game map size is a faithful recreation of the southern half of the island, in a 1:1 scale, including Mt Suribachi’s height of 169m above sea level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/270c317526920f4546d804401d7864e3efe540eb.jpg[/img]

In addition to battling across the expansive topography, there is also an extensive tunnel network through Mt. Suribachi, which opens up more intense close-combat and strategic scenarios. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/a917fe478a5f501a8fa123a3aee2a47cf51343f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/6cfe49fb572ebf51d4481413a375f198fc251d28.jpg[/img]

It was our goal to make this the most faithful representation of Iwo Jima in a game created to date, and utilized countless maps, photos and aerial images to ensure this.

[h2]New Factions - 5th Marine Division and the Imperial Japanese Army[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/be9f7af1a784b005c466ab31cb5b8cd3bf7cb71c.jpg[/img]

The USMC and IJA are the two playable factions available on the Iwo Jima map. A lot of work has been done to ensure that representations are authentic, with unique weapons, utilities, and animations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/cf9fe4eb6f7264f7a10b77c3b7a8cc7cc6c314de.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/bd0044ac0d89c2a6899d7fdadc98ffe79a9e808f.jpg[/img]

The USMC come prepared with unique weapons, including the Winchester M1912 Shotgun and the M2-2 Flamethrower. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/350c71e707d8b3eb310b2e202f9357c4372cc5ab.jpg[/img]

They also have new vehicles, including marine-modified Shermans, and LVT Amphibious Vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/908d1362aa9d3d385dfeb19c3ef10b777e98c62f.jpg[/img]

The IJA have a wide variety of weapons at their disposal, including the Type 38 and Type 99 Arisaka and the Type 95 Shin-Gunto sword. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/89b47c3614921f07a6c5aeb939f8fa62c2115cc5.jpg[/img]
Armour is limited, with vehicles such as the Ha-Go and Chi-Ha tanks, but the IJA have a large number of anti-tank weapons, including the Lunge Mine, for balance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/0928f1572008716879186b230897acca2675203a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/953acc493d3d4153ef5ba3e0f0ff6725d1d1dd1e.jpg[/img]

Check out the full changelog below for complete update details: 

[h2]Changelog - Update 2.0 [/h2]

Please clear the cache before entering a server!

[b]Level Design[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Iwo Jima Map
[list]
[*] 3x Seeding Layers
[*] 2x Frontline layers
[*] 6x Offensive Layers [/list]
[*] Updated Hangar to show more AT weapons on display
[*] Added new MSP/Inf Logi/Cdr car spawners on Best, Carentan, 
[*] Added seeding layers to Grave, Hagenau, Heelsum, Oosterbeek, Maleme, Rethymno
[/list]
[b]Gamemodes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added extra Satchel Charge explosives to attacking Rifleman class on all Frontline layers
[/list]
[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Added attachable bayonet to RSC 1917 Semi-automatic Rifle
[*] Added correctly modelled Berthier M1916 Carbine bayonet
[*] Added M2-2 Flamethrower (USMC)
[*] Added Type 97 81mm deployable mortar (Japanese)
[*] Added WW1-era M1918 BAR, set fire rate to 500rpm, and includes a semi-automatic firing mode.
[*] Added No68 AT Rifle Grenade (ANZAC Grenadier)

notes.title: Update 1.5 is now LIVE - Changelog V1.5
notes.content:
Hey folks!

Our first update that preps us for the Pacific is out now! Make sure to read the changelog below for complete information, but here are the highlights:

[h3]Please note:[/h3]
Due to significant changes to the graphics settings in this patch, it is essential that players reset their cache in-game. Additionally, due to the vast number of changes in the graphics settings user interface, we strongly recommend that players have a look over this video from Moidawg, which helps give context to the new options. While not all of the squad graphics settings discussed in the video will be relevant to Squad 44, it is a 90% solution while we look to work with other content creators on dedicated graphics settings videos for SQ44. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YJt6w69Msr8  

[h2]Pacific Weapons and Vehicles[/h2]

The new weapons and vehicles for the IJA and USMC have been added, and can be accessed through the Arnhem Range, and new Museum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/814833ee80a7c5fd64b96fe6a79d3779e74db8bb.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Museum[/h2]

With this update comes the Museum, a new level to check out all the weapons, uniforms and equipment for each of the factions. This small subway station bunker has lots of little things to explore, so check it out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/8b68bc9d3c47230121085cc3e95effeb6acc4bbf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/a54c9584733459b210b6b5680f7fa756876d19c8.jpg[/img]

[h2]New seeding gamemode[/h2]

Seeding is a tailored game mode similar to a small-scale Advance and Secure match, with all weapons and roles unlocked and available to all. This allows players the opportunity to get to grips with a wider array of faction specific weapons than they would on any other game modes, often in much more closer engagements than they may be used to.

Once 45 players are on the server, the seeding mode will unlock other flags and activate tickets and a game time.

This game mode also features a player kill feed! Seeding layers are available on Arnhem, Best, Carentan, Colmar, Dinant, Doorwerth, Driel, Foy and Maginot. 

[h2]New Admin Tools[/h2]
Server admins, while in admin cam, now have the ability to teleport and move faster around the maps, to jump to specific players and to readily access player information in order to manage players in game.

Those with admin camera access can also activate a kill feed and see more in depth game information.

[h2]Improved Game Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Stamina system has been reworked to be more forgiving and reduce the player’s dependency on the canteen. Equally, amends to the player's movement have been made to give the player a more realistic movement feel
[*] An MG overheating and barrel change feature has been added to the game to increase the levels of immersion for MG players
[*] New full-screen map allowing use of mouse scroll wheel to zoom in and out
[*] New faction-specific sfx have been added to tanks to simulate loader drills
[*] New faction-specific sfx have been added for death and wounded calls
[*] New weapon-specific sfx have been added to various grenades
[*] A fresh animation pass has taken place to improve the animations on a number of weapons in-game
[/list]
As always, check out the full changelog down below for complete update information! And, please let us know your feedback!

notes.title: Dev Blog - The Plan for the Pacific
notes.content:
What a year, recruits!

As we move closer to the release of the Pacific, we wanted to update you on the current plan for its release. We’ve had to pivot a bit, but you’ll still be able to storm the beaches of Iwo Jima before the year ends.

The Iwo Jima map is complete; however, it requires much more extensive testing before our major release. With winter holidays right around the corner, we decided to use this period of time for public playtesting rather than releasing the map too early in an unoptimised state. This way, you’ll still be able to check out Iwo Jima before the end of the year and assist with the map development. The amount of work that has gone into this map is staggering, and we want to give it proper justice. 

So, with all that being said, here’s the current plan for the Iwo Jima release: 

[h2]Phase 1 - Prepping for the Pacific[/h2]

An update will be released this week. It will include a lot of Pacific content, such as the new weapons, vehicles, new faction uniforms, etc., but it will not include the Iwo Jima map. You’ll be able to check out this new content on the Arnhem Range, shooting range, and now our brand new subway Museum, which we showed off during our last livestream.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/814833ee80a7c5fd64b96fe6a79d3779e74db8bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/8b68bc9d3c47230121085cc3e95effeb6acc4bbf.jpg[/img]

This update will also include general bug fixes and new admin tools to help with server administration. Changelog coming soon. 

[h2]Phase 2 - Public Playtests for Iwo Jima[/h2]

Public playtesting for Iwo Jima will start Dec 15th to 16th. This will be done on the Squad 44 - Public Testing app. If you own Squad 44 and do not see this app in your Steam library, click on “View” at the top left and then on “Hidden Games”. You should now be able to download the Squad 44 - Public Testing app. This will be where all public playtests will happen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/afe8cf7c1f16eb5578396a67138bc5d7c1004c59.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/bd220e684f1d21ab9bb4547acaf59e536f2fdd26.png[/img]

There are also discussions about another playtest before the end of December, but this still needs to be confirmed. Once I have more information, I will make an announcement! 

[h2]Phase 3 - Iwo Jima gets released to Squad 44[/h2]

Once the map has been tested extensively and deemed to be in a good place performance-wise, it will be released to the main Squad 44 app, likely in early 2025. Please join us if you’re available during the public playtests, as data from these tests will help us immensely. Even if you’re AFK during the test, sitting on the server allows us to get important information about server load, so please come along if you’re available! 

—

Thank you so much for all your support this year. We plan to continue to be open and transparent with you as we develop Squad 44 going forward. With your support, we can ensure that SQ44 takes its place as the best WW2 tactical FPS out there in 2025.

And for those who missed it, here’s the trailer for the Pacific Front!

[previewyoutube=s1oVFCd5mnM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Nominate Squad 44 for the Steam Awards
notes.content:
With the Steam Autumn Sale kicking off today, nominations for the 2024 Steam Awards are now underway. We hope you'll consider nominating Squad 44 for the Labor of Love Award.

Squad 44 has truly been a labor of love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/dcdb183a37354c961a690a8b81021568c03deaa8.png[/img]
From the people who have developed Squad 44 over the years, to the players who have been with us since the very beginning, Squad 44 is a game that just won’t quit. With the upcoming release of the Pacific Chapter, we can’t wait to see what the future holds.

Over the past year, we announced our plans with the release of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/736220/announcements/detail/4029101838404898212]6-month roadmap[/url], setting the framework for the changes and improvements the team was ready to take on.

In the middle of the year, we released the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/736220/announcements/detail/4178858570785796957]Reign of Steel update[/url], our largest update to date. This update included massive vehicle updates, with around 40 new vehicles joining the Squad 44 arsenal. We also introduced a brand new gamemode, Frontline, which has been receiving great feedback from the community.

[previewyoutube=2JUS5IjnU7Q;full][/previewyoutube]
As the year moved forward, we updated our roadmap and officially announced that we’re [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/736220/announcements/detail/4241909599790307742?snr=2___]introducing the Pacific as the newest theatre[/url] for Squad 44 , with the first update coming before the end of this year. So much hard work and dedication has gone into the making of the first map, [b]Iwo Jima[/b], and we can’t wait to get this update into your hands.

We wouldn’t be here without the incredible support from this community, and for that, we are truly grateful. Being [b]nominated for the Labor of Love Award [/b]would mean so much to us, so please consider choosing Squad 44 for this year's Steam Awards.

If you haven't already, you can pick up Squad 44 for [b]50% off [/b]until the [b]end of the Steam Autumn Sale[/b]. We'll see you on the Pacific Front, soon enough!

notes.title: UPDATE: Squad 44 - Frontline Expanded is now LIVE
notes.content:
Hey there folks! 

The team has been working hard to bring you this latest update, which includes 100-player server functionality, Frontline mode added to more maps and layers, updated mines and explosives, bug fixes and more! Full changelog down below.

[b]After this update, the team's main focus will be towards the Pacific, so regular updates will slow down. [/b]During this time, we plan on showcasing what’s being worked on with livestreams, social posts, dev blogs, etc. Keep your eyes on socials for updates! 

[h2]What’s New[/h2]

[h3]100-Player Server Functionality[/h3]

We have undertaken some UE4 replication optimisation using existing technology from our other Offworld title, Squad. This means servers should run significantly smoother and now allow for 100 players!

Thanks to everyone who came out to our public playtest! 

[h3]New Frontline Gamemode Layers[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/2244081869c69f27163a54c1aecb0c6ed03b5e1d.jpg[/img]

Following the success of the new frontline gamemode, we have rolled it out across all maps in the game. This means players will be able to enjoy the frontline gamemode across all chapters, a total of 20 maps.

Additionally, we have added several new objective types, such as document search, where players have several areas to search to find documents for their squad lead or commander to recover. We have also added a wider variety of objectives to destroy, such as weapon caches, vehicles, deployed mortars, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/a96f4a3054709cb6c81beaa6ef0c8ab86d82ae16.jpg[/img]

[h3]Reign of Steel Tanks added to Armoured Gamemode[/h3]

We have added the new tanks from Reign of Steel into the armoured game mode. This will allow armoured players more opportunities to try out the tanks and compete against one another in all-out armoured combat.

Commander observation cupolas have been overhauled to bring the periscopes much closer together. This makes them more usable for buttoned-up tank commanders by increasing their situational awareness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/976da1467276984e5d011457ae1643aea273415a.jpg[/img]

Armour-Piercing shells have received a tweak in their performance meaning that spalling from these shells is better scaled based on their caliber. The cone in which spalling projectiles occur has also been narrowed to better emphasize the importance of getting an accurate shot on a particular tank component. Depending on the type of armour-piercing ammunition, the amount of hull damage conferred will be different. In general, AP ammunition deals the most damage, but has the least amount of penetration potential. APCR, APCBC, APDS and HVAP ammunition types generally deal less damage but have higher penetration potential. We also increased the minimum bounce angle of HEAT-type ammunition by 50%, meaning that it’ll be much easier to score a hit with HEAT ammunition on an angled surface.

We are also introducing 2 new vehicle variants in this update: the Cromwell Mk.VI ‘Close Support’ (CS) Tank, which sports a 95mm howitzer and lots of high-explosive ammunition, and the AEC Mk. III Armoured Car, which has a powerful QF 75mm gun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/3d3b248c4c499955dd18ca9b046cf3f9b26516f4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/23500e96eced5595c1e6238b27d49b684a203bff.jpg[/img]

[h3]Mine and explosives overhaul[/h3]

We have added in the smoke rocket to the US bazooka and have refined the behavior of mines to reflect their real life abilities. So the ‘Bouncing Betty’ mine (German S-Mines) will now “bounce” up and other mines of the various other factions will reflect their real world performance too. All mines are now placed individually rather than in clusters, and the amount of which you can place has been overall increased. A very noticeable click and delay before detonation also ratchets up the tension after stepping on a mine.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1174392604192935958/1270864570222641254/2024-07-31_11-12-20.gif?ex=66bf239d&is=66bdd21d&hm=5e3cb4c808d3f6916cd25330b72a9c97f8b2113233c044cfbcdcd85bc55a292c&[/img]

Hand grenades as well now have been tweaked to reflect their real life counterparts. An example is the German stick grenade having a wider blast radius but higher damage falloff due to its lack of significant fragmentation, compared to the American Mk2 ‘Pineapple’ grenades or the British Mills Bomb.

American and British fragmentation rifle grenades now also reflect their real life performance and are on a timed fuse rather than an impact detonated fuse. This will mean you’ll need to adjust the way you use these grenades and they will be a far less of a lucrative option to get easy kills. Being on a timed fuse allows you to also shoot them into rooms in close quarters more safely.

[h3]Graphics overhaul continued (Chapter 3)[/h3]

We have worked hard to rework St Mere Eglise and Carentan to be more in line with their historical real world locations. Various building models have been further refined and furniture has been installed in various open buildings to give both maps more of a lived in feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/41ea2c730fbbd28d635883f4c1b812fe1a947f86.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/384be9d0447424e905940d75ab64bb9a064e3061.jpg[/img]
[h3]Bug Fixing[/h3]

We have continued to work on bug fixing and have also been tweaking the performance of various vehicles as well as developing more realistic animations for a lot of weapons in game.

notes.title: UPDATE: Squad 44 - Reign of Steel is now LIVE
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2JUS5IjnU7Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey folks! We have a heavily armoured update for you!

[h1]What’s New[/h1]

[h2]Armour Updates[/h2]

We’re excited to announce that we have collaborated with community member Internoto (Project Variety), and are introducing almost 40 new vehicles and AT guns with this update. This includes:
[list]
[*] Jagdpanzer 38t (Hetzer) (German)
[*] Sturmhaubitze 42 (StuH)  (German)
[*] Panzerwerfer 42  (German)
[*] Ostwind  (German)
[*] Sdkfz 234/3 Stummel  (German)
[*] Marder 3 Ausf. M  (German)
[*] Nashorn  (German)
[*] Sdkfz 251/22 (Pak40)  (German)
[*] leichtes Infanterieschütz 18  (German)
[*] Sturer Emil (German) 
[*] M36 Jackson (US)
[*] Calliope (US)
[*] Sherman M4A3E2 Jumbo (US)
[*] M26 Pershing (US)
[*] M3 Gun Carrier (US)
[*] M20 Utility Car (US)
[*] M1 ATG (US)
[*] AEC Armored Car (UK)
[*] Tetrarch (UK)
[*] Challenger (UK)
[*] Comet (UK)
[*] Valentine Mk XI (UK)
[*] M1919A4 .30cal Willys Jeep (US)
[*] MG42 Kubelwagen (German)
[*] And more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/cac7d77ae8d93ee8fa78d2a13a0006985960e411.jpg[/img]

We have also added some interesting new game mechanics, allowing infantry the ability to ride on friendly tanks, and also to operate mounted MGs on some tanks – adding extra firepower and incentivising combined arms operations in game. Driver-operated smoke launchers have also been fitted to numerous armored vehicles in game, making tanks significantly more formidable opponents.

[h2]New Gamemode - Frontline[/h2]
We gave a sneak peek of Frontline [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/736220/view/4178858570764831309]in this preview[/url], and we’re excited to include it in this update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/896db768c7c92ac1e2d9ad9f21f246458214d621.png[/img]

This mode is still work-in-progress, and will initially be available on three maps as we look to refine it (with your feedback) and roll it out on more maps in future patches. The maps included in this update are:
[list]
[*] Driel
[*] Utah
[*] Veghel 
[/list]

[h2]Arnhem Range Updates[/h2]
The Arnhem Range has had a large overhaul to allow it to include a new tank practice range, a driver training track, an updated infantry shooting range (with pop-up targets), a logistics training area, and a kill house, where players can compete against one another to achieve the title of most deadly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/0e8dc6df6984a8d1137adcd727f4de781c407d29.png[/img]

Arnhem range will be able to be hosted on community servers which will allow players an environment in which they can train and compete together, allowing players to get to know each other while preparing for the fight! We hope this will help clans in particular.

It is also our aspiration that players may be able to access the range in future, while queuing for a live server, making servers queue times significantly more palatable.


[h2]Map Updates[/h2]
In addition to all the new content coming, we have also spent time polishing existing maps, with graphical improvements made to several Chapter 1 maps as well as Chapter 3 maps. Chapter 4 maps have also benefited from improved lighting and shadow work to provide a greater immersive environment for the player. We are, however, most proud of the overhaul of Utah invasion mode, which, in addition to graphics changes, now features wave spawning landing craft and scripted events (like dummy landing craft) to provide that next level of immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/7508998d15f85a68643854447abe474bf9febb18.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Updates[/h2]
Numerous small bugs have been fixed in this update and we hope this will be particularly clear in the use of bayonets and AT guns. Some weapon animations have also been refined and we have aligned weapon sway to relate more to weapon weight, while recoil, bullet penetration, and suppression have been amended to reflect weapon caliber. On top of all of this, we have removed the requirement for rallies to be refreshed after being placed, added faction-specific cinematic end screens and music, created new role icons, and started to put together an up-to-date community drive. This community drive will allow the community to access up-to-date information on all map layers, vehicles, and admin spawn commands.

notes.title: Squad 44 - 6 Month Roadmap Part 2
notes.content:
[h3][i]All information provided in this blog is under development and highly subject to change.[/i][/h3]

[b]Hello Soldiers,[/b]

More top-secret documents have found their way onto my desk, so let’s dig in. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/be8ae6b9a4b7d02e7ed147b0cb247937a6a92236.png[/img]

[h2]SQUAD 44 - 6 Month Roadmap Part 2[/h2]

As a reminder, here’s the meaning behind each of the sections:

[b]Current Operations:[/b]
[list]
[*] These changes are coming soon in the next updates
[/list]
[b]In concept: [/b]
[list]
[*] These are currently being developed for future updates
[/list]
[b]Future Operations: [/b]
[list]
[*] Plans for far into the future, highly subject to change
[/list]

[b]And, as usual, all information provided is subject to change, and if anything changes, we will let you know! [/b]

[h2]Current Operations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Armoured Update
[*] New Gamemode - Frontline
[*] New Environmental meshes
[/list]
We have spent the first 6 months of development largely focused on cleaning up code while improving the graphics and performance of Chapter 1 maps. With this update, a lot of work in this area has continued, with the team also starting to work on improving Chapter 3 maps. Further to that, we have started to add new content and game mechanics to put our own stamp on the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/db53860f1eef1db9add7630da9de71d6f87cf566.png[/img]

For the next update of Squad 44, we have collaborated with community member and modder Internoto (Project Variety) to incorporate almost 40 new vehicles, with tank riding and mounted MG mechanics to incentivise infantry to operate more closely with tanks and push the game towards a more combined arms style of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/dca0d0616985a35509ea089db756d1a85639334f.png[/img]

In addition to this new content, the team has also been working on a new gamemode, Frontline, which was revealed in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/736220/view/4178858570764831309]this sneak peek.[/url] The aim of this new gamemode is to focus gameplay around specific tasks and objectives, rather than across the map, to ensure combat is centralised and more intense, with each squad having a distinct objective to achieve or task to accomplish.

[h2]In Concept[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chapter 3 overhaul
[*] Improved admin features and commands
[*] Extra layers for maps
[*] Optimization and polishing
[*] Re-worked Training Map
[/list]
Work on improving the graphics and performance of Chapter 3 maps remain ongoing, with reworked/new building models, textures, lighting, furnished interiors, and general improvements to graphics and optimization taking place at pace. Historic imagery continues to be used by the level design team to realign maps to be more fitting of reality, with Carentan and St Mere Eglise both being reworked to reflect this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/15699c81cc9a9c8df3c72e95bae13706aaff7efc.jpg[/img]

Admin tools are still in concept and we’ve received great input from server hosters and event organisers to help guide this process. We will be approaching these hosts and organisers again soon to draw up a wish-list of admin tools for development in future.

For new and old players alike, work continues to go into Arnhem Range. So far a new shooting range with pop up targets has been added, a logistics training area, tank driving area and shooting range has been added, along with a kill house for players to compete as most deadly! Work is planned to continue on Arnhem Range as we seek to make it more new player friendly, with the inclusion of player guides and greater direction in future. 

[h2]Future Operations[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Pacific
[/list]
[b]The rumours are true! Squad 44 is going to the Pacific! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/5a2b548b0b5fa7261a965ed19daf9b37aa1c89e4.jpg[/img]

Because the Pacific is in the “Future Operations” category, it will be some time before you storm those beaches; but be under no illusion, work is already ongoing, with multiple weapon models already created, characters being worked on, and map outlines starting to be put together. We are however determined to respect this theatre and make sure we take the time to ensure we develop and flesh out this new theatre properly. The Pacific update will therefore be implemented in multiple patches to allow time for feedback and further development. We’ll keep you informed of our Pacific development throughout the rest of the year with dev diaries and behind-the-scenes content as we seek to be open and transparent with the community on the game's development and its next big step forward. 

As many may have guessed from a teaser we recently posted on our socials, we can confirm that our first map will be Iwo Jima, with two additional maps planned. The USMC and the Japanese will be battling it out in the Pacific initially, which will bring multiple new unique kits and weapons to the game. 

We are really grateful for the community's support and feedback as we continue to develop the game into the future! A huge thank you to our playtesters and server hosters as well as the community at large. We hope you share our excitement for what the future will bring! 

Over and out, soldiers.

notes.title: Update Preview - Frontline Mode
notes.content:
When we first released our[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/736220/view/4029101838404898211] 6-month roadmap,[/url] we teased that a new game mode was in the works. Now that we’re further into the year, we can share this new mode with you.

[h2]Introducing Frontline![/h2]

Frontline combines the best gameplay attributes of invasion, offensive and even RAAS game modes, offering players a more dynamic and immersive experience. 

As the attacker, you will be required to undertake various missions to progress the frontline across the map and win the game. The defenders must stop you!

[h3]Missions[/h3]
The attackers' missions range from destroying an objective (e.g., an AT gun or bunker) to building up an objective (e.g., pontoons) or capturing a specific enemy point. Indeed, a single mission may also not be limited to just one of these functions but could include a combination of these tasks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/951bbbe414ae5203974595c4d38a712dd1e713d6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Fog of War[/h3]
With the exception of the first mission, the remaining missions are randomised in location and type and are hidden from the attacking team, with only the defenders able to see them from the game start. This gives the defenders an advantage and allows their logistics teams time to prepare each objective with defences as required. As the attacker completes their active mission, their visibility will increase to show the next mission, and the frontline will move to offer them the ability to penetrate further and improve their supporting logistics systems.

[h3]Reinforcement[/h3]
For the attacker, both time and tickets will not be on your side. The attacking team will always start with fewer tickets than the defender and will need to achieve missions to gain tickets and time to press on to the next.

[h3]Retreat[/h3]
If the attacker achieves a mission, the defender must retreat and take a new position to defend for the next mission. They will be given preparation time before the next mission goes live. After this preparation time ends, every FOB of the defender inside the new attacker’s frontline is destroyed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/eb0c92e095bc05412665a5b7f0b52cd3421b424c.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Frontline[/h3]
The frontline is simulated by the red zones for both factions, with a neutral area overlapping the two. Each team can only place fortifications or radios behind their red zone frontline or in the neutral area.

[h3]When can I try it?[/h3]
Soon...very, very soon! Our next update is planned to be released before the end of this month, so get ready to try a brand-new game mode!

As always, we’d love to hear your feedback on this new mode in the comments below!

notes.title: Squad 44 Modding Spotlight - Summer 2024
notes.content:
Welcome to the Squad 44 Modding Spotlight, where we showcase some amazing mods made by the community.

[b]We’ll also be doing a livestream with the Post Scriptum Realism Mod (PSRM) development team June 1st, 2024, at 12 PM EST (4 PM GMT) on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/squad44official]Twitch[/url]. Come join and get more info about this great mod![/b]

What follows are updates sent to us by the people behind the mods themselves: their words, images, and amazing work! 

[h2]Project Variety by Internoto[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/94b097075d0bbdf5c4e6cd0e45d5fba603a44577.jpg[/img]

“First of all, I want to introduce myself. I am Tom (known as "Internoto" in the community), a modder and game artist student from Germany and the creator of the "Project Variety" mod for Squad44. Project Variety is a modding project that I started in 2022, with a first release in late January of the same year. Since then, the project has grown into something way bigger than what I expected it to be when I started working on it.

The project´s main target is to bring as many new vehicles into the game as possible, to give the players a big variety of tanks and other vehicles to play with. Especially in World War 2, there was such a big variety of vehicles, so I thought to myself it would be a shame if players couldn´t experience all these vehicles. The mod contains more than 50 new tanks, halftracks and other vehicles, with more to come in the future. Some of these vehicles are completely new models, some are altered models that existed already in the game.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/d4e23b546755233f1b21b651cd98411b904a546a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/f5a757e2870eeaa68f15fadf863002e37db1388f.jpg[/img]

[b]Links:[/b]
Steam Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2724056597 
Follow Internoto: artstation.com/internoto 
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgPTZCUTUgiKAJs_ZtknGoQ 

[h2]FEB (Brazilian Expeditionary Force) by Al-Yasa[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/0a4212d9177b9e7299f5b7318d66890e1f37e34e.jpg[/img]

The mod portrays the Italian front, where the Brazilian expeditionary force took part in important battles: Monte Castello, Montese, and Fornovo. The first map to be developed was Monte Castello, which is still being developed and improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/57ffe5cf46a3f36efcd6d34f7986ac466504208a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/cc86b3a3a6b51cb1f27114e9c07eefac259da09c.jpg[/img]

[b]Links:[/b]
Steam Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927826325 

[h2]Post Scriptum Realism Mod (PSRM) by the PSRM Dev Team[/h2]
[previewyoutube=fKZbAHBN5Xs;full][/previewyoutube]

The Post-Scriptum Realism Mod aims to deliver the most historically accurate and realistic game-play experience possible. Our mod appeals to a more discriminating mature gaming audience and those who expect an uncompromising standard of true-to-life combat, historical accuracy, and WWII simulation. Some of the community's premier realism units have joined forces to unlock the potential that the base game already has and redirect it towards the creation of the ultimate hardcore-for-the-sake-of-fun Mod for Unit Events and beyond. 

Join community manager Luna as she interviews the team behind PSRM, the Post Scriptum Realism Mod this Saturday! 

[b]Live June 1st, 2024, at 12 PM EST (4 PM GMT) on https://www.twitch.tv/squad44official  [/b]

Workshop:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2682656457 

[h2]Sainte-Marie-Du-Mont by Normandy Expanded[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/b86bfb2873b404e59fd47aaf6f7375dc5c596d70.jpg[/img]

Normandy Expanded is a mod for Squad '44 that aims to deliver the highest quality content with exciting improvements to core gameplay mechanics.

Containing a 1:1 recreation of the beautiful and iconic town of Sainte-Marie-Du-Mont, Normandy Expanded offers more realistic overhauls to player and vehicle models, with the further addition of improved weapon handling and stunning visuals.

This is our first full map release with many more to come. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/75148a1bf93422eebd9780379c70b00afbb40481.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/fde51f229c06aa84219341f5c0c2482b48cc97fd.jpg[/img]

[b]Links:[/b]
Steam Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2953872280 


[h2]Saint-Lo by Salami1991[/h2]
[previewyoutube=wOeVAUxNDVc;full][/previewyoutube]

I present my fourth map: Saint-Lo

A huge city surrounded by bocage, farms and woods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/fa7676a51914bcaa71aed1d9a0f6db972cc294a6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/f8e32fe0c258de38bfcc704a7627c91afff2fcd8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Training Mod and Armoured Mod by Project Steel[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/c743e490f2b74efabbd6491cec621836f1f53fef.png[/img]

The Training Mod is for beginners as well as advanced players. The mod offers an infantry shooting range where all current infantry weapons can be tested. Right next to the infantry shooting range, there are three tank shooting ranges where all vanilla, Project Variety and Project Steel tanks can be spawned at different distances (0m - 500m) and rotations (0 degrees - 360 degrees). It is also possible to change the weather, so you have the opportunity to train in the sun, at night or even in the rain. Another advantage is that the mod works locally as well as on a server, so you can train alone or with friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31533869/c0967b1b42302c72e2fa1860b577d477b58a2a9e.png[/img]

The Armored Mod is a non-historical armored-based mod. The mod offers a custom armoured game mode, camouflage changing system for tanks, tank smoke launcher, custom faction ("14th Armored Division" vs. "9. SS Panzer"), custom landing boats, mobile repair trucks, custom logistic buildables, destructible lights, custom air support and many more features.
The mod also has its own map that is designed for perfect tank combat.
